title: Term Limit of a Lowered Patient Payment Plan Schedule
content:
**Rule.** The term limit of a lowered **Patient Payment Plan** schedule is 60 installments when the open application's household was screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level and 48 installments when it was screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, each only on tiers whose maximum term is shorter; otherwise it is the tier's maximum term.

**Open application.** A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

| Tier | Tier maximum term | At or below 200% FPL | Above 200%, at or below 400% FPL | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 60 | 48 | 6 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 60 | 48 | 12 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 60 | 48 | 24 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 60 | 48 | 36 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 60 | 48 | 48 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

**Hypothetical.** On a tier with a 24-installment maximum term and 10 installment payment entries numbered 1 or more, a household at 150 percent FPL gives a term limit of 60; at 350 percent, 48; with no open application, 24.
